description: Active custom shipping method with the given code and a flat-rate rule, associated with the store, that returns a rate for every listed destination country, so Estimate Shipping and checkout offer it. KB: Managing Shipping Methods; Associating Shipping Rules with a Shipping Method.

shippingCode.description: ZnodeShipping.ShippingCode of the option the page objects click (FLAT for #Flat-1)

countries.description: Comma-separated list (no list type in the schema) of destination country codes the test estimates for, e.g. us,ca; the method must return a rate for each

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
